source.publisher: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations

access.summary: Official monthly OPEN-NY bulk/API extract under revocable reuse terms; no current endpoint transport was attempted.

fields: DOS ID, current entity name, filing date, jurisdiction, type, county and location address are selectable; process, CEO and agent fields remain excluded.
status_semantics: Active filing persists until formal dissolution, surrender or termination and is not proof of present operation, licensure, solvency or public access.
address_zip: Location and service addresses are not verified operating premises; ZIP may contain five or nine digits and must be split without inventing ZIP+4.
temporal: The official extract is monthly and excludes inactive entities; indexed update evidence does not replace current metadata verification or an app receipt.

citations.evidence: Official monthly active-entity dataset, scope and limitations.
Official machine-readable API and field documentation.

strongest_next_action: Verify and reuse the retained release; complete tested CLI cancellation handoff before any fresh app-managed source operation.
